blocks.text: 这对 AI 经济意味着什么？

inlines.text: 这对 AI 经济意味着什么？

blocks.alt: Nvidia deployed 112% of its operating cash flow into equity investments & M&A last quarter

blocks.text: 1. 如果“AI 央行”收紧政策，AI 经济就会放缓。过去两年，英伟达在并购与技术收购上投入了 420 亿美元，2按成本计投入 610 亿美元现金，入股 229 家初创公司和 13 家上市公司，3并提供了 1645 亿美元的租赁担保与云容量兜底，这些承诺需要相应计提资本储备；此外还有 631 亿美元的客户应收账款，付款期限如今最长可达整整一年。45在财务纪律更严、董事会审查更紧的新体制下，无论是收紧股权投资、付款条件还是租赁兜底，都会让 AI 建设放缓——就像美联储收紧信贷时整体经济会放缓一样。

按成本计投入 610 亿美元现金，入股 229 家初创公司和 13 家上市公司，
并提供了 1645 亿美元的租赁担保与云容量兜底，这些承诺需要相应计提资本储备；此外还有 631 亿美元的客户应收账款，付款期限如今最长可达整整一年。

blocks.text: 2. 英伟达以前所未有的方式把初创生态与芯片生态融为一体。在黄仁勋治下，英伟达同时扮演着 200 多家初创公司的芯片供应商、领投方、锚定云客户和租赁担保人。这些交易靠的是黄仁勋个人的信念与人脉。如今英伟达需要一位新领导者，在缔造这些关系的联合创始人离开后，继续维系与创始人们的合作。

blocks.text: 3. 开源初创公司失去了最大的金主和买家。英伟达一直是美国开源 AI 公司最大的单一买家和出资方，为其 Nemotron 技术栈向 Hugging Face、Poolside 和 Essential AI 投入了 220 亿美元：没有其他公司如此大规模地收购开源团队。6Meta、Google 以及至少八家融资超过 1 亿美元的美国初创公司仍在训练开放权重模型，7今后它们得自己扛起更多美国开源的大旗。

blocks.text: “AI 央行”的领导层更替，是行业的转折点。英伟达在美国经济增长最快的板块中，对初创融资、并购退出和政策的影响力之大，怎么强调都不为过。最高层的突然交接给市场带来了真实的不确定性，初创公司尤其如此。

英伟达新闻室，
NVIDIA 宣布 CEO 交接
，2026 年 11 月 12 日：黄仁勋辞去总裁、CEO 及董事会成员职务，即刻生效；执行副总裁兼 CFO Colette Kress 被任命为临时 CEO，Harvey C. Jones 被任命为董事会主席。

英伟达2025与2026年并购及战略技术收购（合计420亿美元）：Groq（200亿美元LPU技术授权及工程团队人才收购，2025年12月，根据SEC文件，其中130亿美元于FY26第四季度支付，29.4亿美元于FY27第二季度支付）、Hugging Face（129.3亿美元收购，2026年9月3日宣布）、Poolside（60亿美元Model Factory非独家授权，并将109名Laguna工程师转入Nemotron，2026年8月）、Enfabrica（9亿美元网络技术授权及团队）、Run:ai（7亿美元）、Gretel（3.2亿美元）、Deci（3亿美元）、Shoreline（1亿美元）、Brev、SchedMD、CentML及Essential AI（2026年6月）。

英伟达10-K表（FY26）及截至2026年7月26日的第二季度10-Q表（2026年8月26日提交）：过去八个季度购买权益证券的累计现金支出按成本计算合计608亿美元（FY25为14.9亿美元，FY26为175.0亿美元，FY27上半年为424.0亿美元，另有250.0亿美元待定权益承诺）。计入累计343亿美元未实现按市值计价收益（FY26为106亿美元，FY27上半年为237亿美元）后，英伟达资产负债表上的账面公允价值达到940亿至990亿美元，覆盖229家非上市公司及13家上市公司。已披露持股包括对OpenAI的300亿美元、对Anthropic最高100亿美元，以及SpaceX/xAI、CoreWeave、Safe Superintelligence、英特尔、Nebius、Synopsys及Poolside。

英伟达FY27第二季度10-Q表表外承诺（供应、云及担保义务合计5305亿美元）及附注7（补充财务报表信息）：或有信贷及产能支持合计1645亿美元，包括1085亿美元的租赁及债务违约担保（其中以最高1050亿美元为OpenAI在俄亥俄州与SB Energy的数据中心租赁提供支持为首），360亿美元多年期新云照付不议产能协议（包括CoreWeave至2032年的63亿美元剩余产能担保及Lambda的15亿美元协议），以及英伟达为转租给新云合作伙伴而签署的200亿美元15年期数据中心租赁。这些担保在触发前不计入表内，但要求英伟达维持大量流动性储备。资产负债表上，应收账款从FY26年末的385亿美元跃升至FY27第二季度的631亿美元（六个月内消耗246亿美元经营现金流），五名客户占应收账款的70%（分别为22%、14%、13%、11%及10%）。应收账款周转天数（DSO）从47.8天的10年历史均值拉长至60至65天，附注7披露了从90天到整整一年的延长付款期限，用于为客户的数据中心建设提供融资。

过去四个季度，英伟达产生1344亿美元经营现金流，并将758亿美元直接投入股权收购与并购：上季度达到峰值270亿美元，相当于经营现金流的112%。英伟达简明合并现金流量表（截至2026年1月25日的FY26 10-K表，以及截至2026年7月26日的FY27第一季度和第二季度10-Q表）。季度经营现金流与投入权益证券及并购/Groq收购的现金流出对比：FY25第三季度（经营现金流+176.3亿美元 vs. 投入-7.6亿美元，4%）、FY25第四季度（+166.3亿美元 vs. -10.2亿美元，6%）、FY26第一季度（+274.1亿美元 vs. -10.3亿美元，4%）、FY26第二季度（+153.7亿美元 vs. -8.9亿美元，6%）、FY26第三季度（+237.5亿美元 vs. -41.5亿美元，18%）、FY26第四季度（+361.9亿美元 vs. -259.7亿美元，72%）、FY27第一季度（+503.4亿美元 vs. -186.7亿美元，37%）及FY27第二季度（+240.8亿美元 vs. -269.8亿美元，112%）。

英伟达总额 220 亿美元的开源与 Nemotron 承诺，由以下几部分构成：129.3 亿美元收购 Hugging Face（2026 年 9 月）；70 亿美元与 Poolside 的交易（60 亿美元模型工厂授权 + 10 亿美元股权融资，2026 年 8 月）；对 Essential AI 的收购式招聘（该公司由 Transformer 共同作者 Ashish Vaswani 与 Niki Parmar 创立，2026 年 6 月）；以及 20 亿美元的 Nemotron 联盟开放权重模型与数据集资助。

美国已融资至少 1 亿美元、用于训练开放权重模型的初创公司包括：Thinking Machines Lab（20 亿美元种子轮，估值 400 亿美元，已推出 Inkling 开放模型）、Poolside（融资逾 16 亿美元，估值 120 亿美元）、Together AI（融资逾 5.3 亿美元，估值 75 亿美元）、Liquid AI（融资逾 2.5 亿美元，估值 23 亿美元，Liquid Foundation Models）、Arcee AI（2026 年 9 月完成逾 1.5 亿美元 B 轮融资，估值 10 亿美元）、Reflection AI（融资逾 1.3 亿美元，2026 年 10 月推出 5010 亿参数的开放权重模型 Beam）、Prime Intellect（2026 年 7 月完成 1.3 亿美元 A 轮融资，估值 10 亿美元，INTELLECT 系列模型）以及 Deep Cogito（融资逾 1 亿美元，Cogito-v2.1-671B 开放权重模型）。
TrendForce 与
Tom’s Hardware

（2026 年 5 月）：2026 年定制 AI ASIC 服务器出货量占 AI 服务器市场的 27.8%（同比增长 44.6%，而商用 GPU 为 16.1%），占数据中心 AI 加速器收入的 15% 至 20%。在定制芯片内部，Google TPU 占据 64.8% 至 65.1% 的份额，其后是 AWS Trainium 与 Inferentia（14.6%）、Meta MTIA（8.7%）、Microsoft Maia（6.4%）以及 OpenAI/新兴项目（5.5%）。

blocks.text: What are the implications for the AI economy?

inlines.text: What are the implications for the AI economy?

blocks.alt: Nvidia deployed 112% of its operating cash flow into equity investments & M&A last quarter

blocks.text: 1. If the Central Bank of AI tightens policy, the AI economy slows. Over the past two years, Nvidia committed $42b to M&A & technology buyouts,2 invested $61b of cash on a cost basis into equity stakes across 229 startups & 13 public companies,3 & extended $164.5b in lease guarantees & cloud capacity backstops that require capital reserves alongside $63.1b in customer receivables, where payment terms now stretch up to a full year.45 Under a more financially disciplined regime facing heightened board scrutiny, any tightening of those equity checks, payment terms or lease backstops will slow AI buildouts just as the broader economy slows when the Federal Reserve tightens credit.

inlines.text: 1. If the Central Bank of AI tightens policy, the AI economy slows.
Over the past two years, Nvidia committed $42b to M&A & technology buyouts,
invested $61b of cash on a cost basis into equity stakes across 229 startups & 13 public companies,
& extended $164.5b in lease guarantees & cloud capacity backstops that require capital reserves alongside $63.1b in customer receivables, where payment terms now stretch up to a full year.

Under a more financially disciplined regime facing heightened board scrutiny, any tightening of those equity checks, payment terms or lease backstops will slow AI buildouts just as the broader economy slows when the Federal Reserve tightens credit.

blocks.text: 2. Nvidia fused the startup & chip ecosystems in a way we have never seen. Under Huang, Nvidia acted simultaneously as chip supplier, lead venture investor, anchor cloud customer & lease guarantor across more than 200 startups. Those deals ran on Huang’s personal conviction & relationships. Nvidia now needs a leader who can sustain these founder partnerships without the co-founder who built them.

blocks.text: 3. Open-source startups lose their primary patron & buyer. Nvidia has been the single largest buyer & financier of American open-source AI companies, committing $22b to its Nemotron stack across Hugging Face, Poolside & Essential AI : no other company has bought open-source teams at scale.6 Meta, Google & at least eight US startups that have raised $100m or more continue to train open-weight models,7 & they will now have to carry more of the American open-source mantle themselves.

blocks.text: The change of leadership at the Central Bank of AI is a pivotal moment for the industry. It is hard to overstate how central Nvidia has become to startup financing, M&A exits & policy across the fastest-growing segment of the US economy. A sudden transition at the top introduces real uncertainty into the market & especially in startups.

Nvidia Newsroom,
NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition

, November 12, 2026 : Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO & member of the Board effective immediately ; EVP & CFO Colette Kress was appointed Interim CEO & Harvey C. Jones was appointed Chair of the Board.

Nvidia 2025 & 2026 M&A & strategic technology buyouts ($42b total) : Groq ($20.0b LPU technology license & engineering acqui-hire, December 2025, with $13.0b paid in Q4 FY26 & $2.94b in Q2 FY27 per SEC filings), Hugging Face ($12.93b acquisition announced September 3, 2026), Poolside ($6.0b Model Factory non-exclusive license & transfer of 109 Laguna engineers into Nemotron, August 2026), Enfabrica ($900m networking license & team, September 2025), Run:ai ($700m), Gretel ($320m), Deci ($300m), Shoreline ($100m), Brev, SchedMD, CentML & Essential AI (June 2026).

Nvidia Form 10-K (FY26) & Form 10-Q for the second quarter ended July 26, 2026 (filed August 26, 2026) : cumulative cash paid for purchases of equity securities over the last eight quarters totals $60.8b on a cost basis ($1.49b in FY25, $17.50b in FY26 & $42.40b in 1H FY27, with an additional $25.0b in pending equity commitments). Including $34.3b of cumulative unrealized mark-to-market gains ($10.6b in FY26 & $23.7b in 1H FY27), the carrying fair value on Nvidia’s balance sheet reached $94.0b to $99.0b across 229 private companies & 13 public companies. Disclosed stakes include $30.0b in OpenAI, up to $10.0b in Anthropic, SpaceX/xAI, CoreWeave, Safe Superintelligence, Intel, Nebius, Synopsys & Poolside.

Nvidia Q2 FY27 Form 10-Q off-balance-sheet commitments ($530.5b total across supply, cloud & guarantee obligations) & Note 7 (Supplemental Financial Statement Information) : contingent credit & capacity backstops total $164.5b, comprising $108.5b in lease & debt default guarantees (led by an up-to-$105.0b backstop on OpenAI’s Ohio data center leases with SB Energy), $36.0b in multi-year neocloud take-or-pay capacity agreements (including CoreWeave’s $6.3b residual capacity guarantee through 2032 & Lambda’s $1.5b agreement) & $20.0b in 15-year data center leases signed by Nvidia for reassignment to neocloud partners. While off balance sheet unless triggered, these guarantees require Nvidia to maintain substantial liquidity reserves. On the balance sheet, accounts receivable jumped from $38.5b at FY26 end to $63.1b in Q2 FY27 (consuming $24.6b of operating cash flow in six months), with five customers representing 70% of receivables (22%, 14%, 13%, 11% & 10%). Days sales outstanding (DSO) stretched from a 47.8-day 10-year historical average to 60 to 65 days as Note 7 disclosed extended payment terms ranging from 90 days up to one full year to finance customer data center builds.

Over the past four quarters, Nvidia generated $134.4b in operating cash flow & put $75.8b straight into equity stakes & acquisitions : peaking last quarter at $27.0b, or 112% of operating cash flow. Nvidia Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (Form 10-K for FY26 ended January 25, 2026 & Form 10-Q for Q1 & Q2 FY27 ended July 26, 2026). Quarterly operating cash flow vs. cash outflows into equity securities & acquisitions/Groq buyout : Q3 FY25 (+$17.63b OCF vs. -$0.76b deployed, 4%), Q4 FY25 (+$16.63b vs. -$1.02b, 6%), Q1 FY26 (+$27.41b vs. -$1.03b, 4%), Q2 FY26 (+$15.37b vs. -$0.89b, 6%), Q3 FY26 (+$23.75b vs. -$4.15b, 18%), Q4 FY26 (+$36.19b vs. -$25.97b, 72%), Q1 FY27 (+$50.34b vs. -$18.67b, 37%) & Q2 FY27 (+$24.08b vs. -$26.98b, 112%).

Nvidia’s $22b open-source & Nemotron commitments combine the $12.93b Hugging Face acquisition (September 2026), the $7.0b Poolside deal ($6.0b Model Factory license + $1.0b equity round, August 2026), the acqui-hire of Essential AI (founded by Transformer co-authors Ashish Vaswani & Niki Parmar, June 2026) & $2.0b in Nemotron Alliance open-weight model & dataset grants.

US startups that have raised at least $100m to train open-weight models include Thinking Machines Lab ($2.0b seed at $40b valuation, shipping Inkling open models), Poolside ($1.6b+ raised at $12b valuation), Together AI ($530m+ raised at $7.5b valuation), Liquid AI ($250m+ raised at $2.3b valuation, Liquid Foundation Models), Arcee AI ($150m+ Series B in September 2026 at $1b valuation), Reflection AI ($130m+ raised, shipping the 501b-parameter open-weight Beam model in October 2026), Prime Intellect ($130m Series A in July 2026 at $1b valuation, INTELLECT models) & Deep Cogito ($100m+ raised, Cogito-v2.1-671B open-weight model).
TrendForce &
Tom’s Hardware

(May 2026) : custom AI ASIC server shipments reached 27.8% of the AI server market in 2026 (growing 44.6% YoY vs. 16.1% for merchant GPUs), representing 15% to 20% of data center AI accelerator revenue. Within custom silicon, Google TPU holds 64.8% to 65.1% share, followed by AWS Trainium & Inferentia (14.6%), Meta MTIA (8.7%), Microsoft Maia (6.4%) & OpenAI/emerging programs (5.5%).
